questions.question: Q1 What is the primary purpose of ion implantation in semiconductor manufacturing?

answers.a: To deposit thin films on the wafer
answers.b: To introduce controlled dopant atoms into silicon

explanations.a: Thin films are added during deposition processes.
explanations.b: Correct! Ion implantation introduces dopant atoms into silicon to modify its electrical properties.
explanations.c: Oxide removal is performed during etching.
explanations.d: Crystal growth occurs during wafer manufacturing.

questions.question: Q2 Which of the following is commonly used as a P-type dopant during ion implantation?

explanations.a: Correct! Boron is the most common P-type dopant.
explanations.c: Arsenic is also an N-type dopant.

questions.question: Q3 Which of the following is commonly used as an N-type dopant?

explanations.b: Gallium is also a P-type dopant.
explanations.c: Correct! Phosphorus is widely used for N-type doping.
explanations.d: Aluminum is not commonly used for ion implantation.

questions.question: Q4 Which component accelerates ions to high energy before they strike the wafer?

explanations.a: The wafer chuck only holds the wafer.
explanations.b: Correct! The acceleration column accelerates ions using high voltage.

questions.question: Q5 Which device separates ions according to their mass-to-charge ratio?

explanations.a: Diffusion furnaces do not separate ions.
explanations.b: Correct! The magnetic analyzer selects the required ion species.
explanations.c: Etching removes material from the wafer.
explanations.d: Sputtering targets are used in PVD.

questions.question: Q6 Increasing implantation energy mainly affects which parameter?

explanations.b: Correct! Higher implantation energy results in deeper junctions.
explanations.c: Oxide thickness is unrelated to implantation.

questions.question: Q7 Ion dose primarily controls which property?

explanations.b: Correct! Ion dose determines the number of implanted dopant atoms.
explanations.c: Crystal orientation is fixed during wafer growth.

questions.question: Q8 Why is a high-vacuum environment required during ion implantation?

answers.b: To prevent ions from colliding with air molecules

explanations.a: Cooling is not the primary purpose.
explanations.b: Correct! Vacuum allows ions to travel without scattering.
explanations.d: Oxide growth is performed during oxidation.

questions.question: Q9 Which process is commonly performed after ion implantation to repair crystal damage?

explanations.a: Correct! Annealing repairs lattice damage and activates dopants.

questions.question: Q10 Why is ion implantation preferred over thermal diffusion in modern semiconductor fabrication?

answers.a: It uses lower temperatures and provides precise control of dopant concentration and depth
answers.b: It completely eliminates the need for annealing
answers.c: It does not require dopant atoms

explanations.a: Correct! Ion implantation provides excellent control over junction depth and dopant concentration.
explanations.b: Annealing is still required after implantation.
explanations.c: Dopants are essential for ion implantation.
